To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
medical psychology is a science of human behavior, a discipline of medical science and a profession of medical practice.
medical psychology is an important part of the medical care and it can be a useful instrument in everyday medical care.
medical psychology in Hungary is a relatively new field of study, and it has not yet been integrated into the education of medical students.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How do the medical and the psychological approaches to health and disease relate?
the development of a new approach to the study of medical psychology in the field of medical psychology in Hungarian medical schools.
the following questions: How does medical psychology contribute to the development of the medical profession and to the enhancement of the quality of medical care?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the medical psychologist is a specialist in the field of medical psychology, a medical psychologist who can provide the necessary psychological support to patients and relatives, who can provide psychological assistance to the medical care team, and who is a specialist in medical education and medical training.
in Hungary, medical psychology is a well established discipline with a rich history and tradition.
the medical psychology is a valid, evidence-based, scientifically grounded, well-established and widely accepted branch of medicine in Hungary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

medical psychology is a multidisciplinary, evidence-based science, the aim of which is to understand the complex interactions of mind and body in order to improve the prevention, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of health and disease.
medical psychology in Hungary is in a process of development.
medical psychology is a valid, evidence-based component of everyday medical care and that it can be integrated into the everyday practice of medical care.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the medical psychology is a science of its own right, which is based on evidence, and which is a constitutive part of the medical care.
medical psychology has a long tradition in Hungary.
medical psychology and psychosomatic medicine is a valid and essential part of medical care.
